narrative.overview: A calm, high-signal product view of campus life. Restrained dark surfaces and one electric-blue signal keep discovery fast, alive, and trustworthy.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained dark surfaces with one clear blue signal
High-signal event metadata and visible source provenance
Precise familiar controls with generous mobile targets
Social energy expressed through event content

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue indicates an action, active state, or trusted source. It is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Lift Must Mean Something Rule
rules.body: A shadow indicates hierarchy or interaction. Otherwise use tonal layering and a subtle border.

rules.name: The Product Scale Rule
rules.body: App typography uses fixed restrained steps. Fluid display typography belongs only on marketing surfaces.

dos: Prioritise time, location, vibe, organiser, and source freshness on event cards.
Use Signal Blue for primary actions, active state, and trusted source indicators.
Use familiar product controls with clear focus states and large mobile targets.
donts: Do not make Hermes look like a Waterloo administration website or generic events portal.
Do not use neon social styling, excessive decorative motion, or vague AI SaaS gradients.
Do not use gradient text, colored side stripes, decorative glassmorphism, or identical card grids.
